subject: Hosted API hands-on lab slot — confirmation + timezone check
messages:
From: Avery Chen <avery@averylabs.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: Hosted API evaluation — hands-on lab request

Hi Diego,

I signed up for the Hosted API evaluation yesterday and selected the hands-on lab option. Myself (Avery) and our ML engineer Samir are hoping to do a short, targeted session next week focused on onboarding code samples, latency profiling, and the hosted-to-dedicated migration story.

Two quick constraints: we are on Pacific time and prefer a 30–40 minute window, ideally in the morning. Also Samir is remote in India (IST) and will join late evening his time. Are there any slots you recommend that cover both time zones?

Thanks — looking forward to getting a sandbox up.

Avery Chen
Product @ Avery Labs
avery@averylabs.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Avery Chen <avery@averylabs.com>, Samir Patel <samir@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Hosted API evaluation — hands-on lab request

Hi Avery — thanks for signing up and for the details. I can run a focused 35-minute hands-on lab that hits the items you listed: quick onboarding, sampling latency profiles with your typical prompt load, and a brief discussion about migration paths to Dedicated.

Proposed slots (all Pacific Time, will include IST equivalents in the calendar invite):
- Tue 2026-12-02, 09:00–09:35 PT (Tue 19:30–20:05 IST)
- Tue 2026-12-02, 11:00–11:35 PT (Tue 21:30–22:05 IST)
- Wed 2026-12-03, 08:30–09:05 PT (Wed 19:00–19:35 IST)

If none of those work I can offer a late slot Wed 23:00 PT which is very late for me but might match other schedules. Ben (copied) can also hop in for the migration Q&A if useful.

If you confirm one I will send a calendar invite with a short prep doc and a sandbox link.

Best,

Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0126 | diego@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir@averylabs.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Chen <avery@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Hosted API evaluation — hands-on lab request

Thanks Diego — appreciate the options. The 11:00 PT slot on Dec 2 looks best for us (21:30 IST is doable). Can you make it 40 minutes instead of 35 so we have time to run a small sample job and look at traces? If Ben can stick around for the migration bit that would be great.

Also can you confirm whether the sandbox will be pre-seeded with a small test dataset (we want to reproduce a few latency spikes we saw with our current setup)? If not, I'll send a tiny example payload ahead of time.

Cheers,
Samir
Senior ML Engineer, Avery Labs
samir@averylabs.com

Perfect — locking in Tue 2026-12-02, 11:00–11:40 PT (21:30–22:10 IST). Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=hostedapi-demo-20261202

What I'll include before the session:
- Redwood_HandsOnGuide.pdf (short checklist + code snippets)
- a small sandbox with a pre-seeded test corpus (I uploaded a 100-row CSV matching your payload format)
- mutual_action_plan.xlsx (outline of next milestones if you want a Dedicated eval)

Ben and Marissa will join the last 10 minutes for the migration and pricing Q&A. If you want to drop the exact payload you mentioned here, I'll make sure the test run uses it so we can reproduce the latency profile.

Attachments: Redwood_HandsOnGuide.pdf (application/pdf), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Looking forward to it — see you Tuesday.
